dragon.name: Ember
dragon.desc: A pocket dragon who codes with the laptop in its lap. It dozes off when you stop typing, rears back and breathes fire when a run goes green, and braces itself when one doesn't.

shark.name: Chomp
shark.desc: A small shark who has never once been intimidated by a stack trace. Lunges and snaps when you say hello, sleeps with its teeth showing.

penguin.name: Waddle
penguin.desc: A penguin in a permanent dinner jacket. Greets you with a belly slide, reviews your code standing very still, and naps upright like penguins do.

octopus.name: Squish
octopus.desc: Eight arms, one laptop, no clear division of labour. Wiggles all of them at once when it is pleased and blows bubbles while it thinks.

fox.name: Zoom
fox.desc: A fox with a white muzzle and no patience for slow builds. Bolts sideways in a blur of speed lines when it wants your attention.

crab.name: Pinch
crab.desc: A red crab on eye stalks who only ever approaches a problem sideways. Scuttles across the desk clicking both claws, then settles back over the keyboard.

sloth.name: Doze
sloth.desc: Gets there. Takes a full second and a half to finish a stretch, sleeps at every opportunity, and reviews your diff with the unhurried confidence of someone who will not be rushed.

clawd.name: Pip
clawd.desc: A small round creature the colour of a sunrise, with three little points on its head. Rises up on its toes in a shower of stars when something finally works.

dino.name: Rex
dino.desc: A green dinosaur with two spikes and a mouthful of teeth, folded improbably behind a laptop. Celebrates by stomping hard enough to rattle the desk.

tiger.name: Stripe
tiger.desc: An orange tiger with black stripes and a white muzzle. Spins on the spot when a run passes, and is asleep within twenty seconds of you walking away.

human.name: Dev
human.desc: A person in a blue shirt, doing the same job as you, slightly more cheerfully. Leans in and waves when it wants to be noticed.

cat.name: Mochi
cat.desc: A grey cat with whiskers that stick out past the frame. Crouches, then pounces, then goes straight back to sitting on the laptop.

frog.name: Pesto
frog.desc: A green frog whose eyes sit on top of its head, so it can watch the build and the door at the same time. Hops twice and ribbits when a run goes green.

robot.name: Bolt
robot.desc: A boxy robot with a cyan visor and a small antenna. Glitches enthusiastically as a greeting, which it insists is intentional.

owl.name: Otto
owl.desc: A brown owl with enormous eyes and two ear tufts, built for the hours you are actually working. Flaps and hoots, then goes back to staring.

bunny.name: Biscuit
bunny.desc: A cream bunny with long pink-lined ears. Boings twice on the spot when something passes and folds its ears down when it doesn't.

bear.name: Barley
bear.desc: A brown bear who takes up most of the desk and rumbles when pleased. Slow, warm, and unbothered by a red test run.
